SUMMARY 
Full-stack software developer with hands-on experience across the MERN stack, REST API design, and backend systems. Practical 
experience building GenAI/RAG-powered applications using LangChain, FAISS, and LLM -based retrieval pipelines. Strong CS 
fundamentals in data structures, OOP, and database design. 
PROJECTS 
Multi-Document RAG JD Analyzer | LIVE DEMO | GITHUB FastAPI, LangChain, OpenAI Embeddings, FAISS 
• Engineered a multi-document RAG pipeline (FastAPI, LangChain, OpenAI Embeddings, FAISS), evaluated across 10–15 
resumes and job descriptions for semantic search and context-aware question answering. 
• Optimized chunking, embedding generation, and FAISS vector retrieval to return context-relevant answers within a 1–3 
second response time per query. 
• Designed prompt-engineered LLM response generation over retrieved context, exposed through FastAPI REST endpoints for 
scalable document processing. 
Collab-Docs — Real-Time Collaborative Document Editor | LIVE DEMO | GITHUB MERN, Yjs, Socket.IO, JWT 
• Developed a real-time collaborative document editor (MERN, Yjs CRDTs) enabling conflict -free simultaneous editing, 
achieving near-real-time sync latency under 200ms, validated with 2+ concurrent users editing the same document 
in live use. 
• Architected a hybrid real-time layer combining Yjs (WebSockets) for document synchronization with Socket.IO for presence 
indicators, live events, and dashboard updates. 
• Implemented JWT-authenticated, role-based access control (Owner/Editor) with bcrypt password hashing to secure 
document access. 
EXPERIENCE 
Full Stack Developer Intern — Code X Tech June 2026 – July 2026 
• Engineered a Team Management module for an esports tournament platform (MERN stack) with full CRUD 
functionality, managing 100+ teams of up to 6 players each including a designated manager per team. 
• Built Excel/CSV import and export workflows using XLSX with data validation, automated roster generation, and 
manager/substitute logic, processing team rosters of 4–6 players each in bulk and cutting estimated manual data-
entry effort by 70–90%. 
• Implemented frontend and backend validation to maintain data integrity through unique UID management, role-based roster 
rules, and synchronization between imported and manually created records.  
• Delivered new features into a shared development branch through Git/GitHub feature branches, pull requests, and 
code reviews, keeping the codebase stable during active team development
